restoration_note: The teaching describes three icons (registers) of the inner life in the righteous: pneumatic (New Man, where Mind of Light dwells), psychic (residue/remainder still mingled with passions), and somatic (outermost, where soul descends to feed). The Living Soul daily passes through all three, laying off body in the somatic, laying off passions in the psychic, and conjoining inward with patience/faith/love (Virgin of Light) in the pneumatic. Most gaps are line-break completions of standard formulae (icon, New Man, Indweller, Virgin of Light, paint/adorn, redeem, purify), which I've confirmed against editor proposals with high confidence. The middle section (5267-5274) describing the somatic descent and emergence of the Virgin contains substantive lacunae that resist restoration: I have left {12}-{15}, {18}, {20}-{23}, and {49} unrestorable since the surrounding Coptic provides only the affection-list framework without enough constraint to fix specific terms.
